meta.title: How To Travel Vietnam (2026) | 2 Week and 1 Month Itineraries
meta.description:
If planning your trip to Vietnam feels overwhelming, get in touch with our friend Adam! He's been a tour guide all over Vietnam and is currently based in Hoi An. Check out his tours and tell him we sent you!
https://www.authenticadventuresbyadam.com/

comments.text: I hope you have the best time! Please take into account that Sept is the end of typhoon season so keep an eye on the weather before you book an activity

comments.author: @tedshoemaker4102
comments.text: @travelsfromyesterday  thanks for that!   Just curious, are there overnight tour boats that only advertise locally in Cat Ba?  Wondering if any cost savings if we would decide not prebooking?

comments.author: @travelsfromyesterday
comments.text: @tedshoemaker4102  Our friend is a tour guide in Vietnam, he said that you'll get the cheapest price on overnight tours if you reach out ahead of time. He said to message them and see if they'll offer a deal. In person, the price will be set in stone
